text: Saptashwa is highly proficient in modern Frontend development, specifically using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+). He focuses on writing clean, semantic code and implementing responsive design to ensure websites work on all devices.
He began specializing in Python in 2025, using it for automation scripts and backend logic. This shift allowed him to bridge the gap between interactive interfaces and data-driven functionality.
His programming journey started in 2023 (9th Grade) with Java. This provided him with a strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and logical problem-solving.

One of his standout projects is this interactive portfolio. It features a custom physics-based 'Journey' page and an integrated AI search bar, demonstrating his ability to combine creative UX with technical complexity.
Saptashwa is currently developing a series of utility web apps and a personal music-tech integration project. He maintains a GitHub repository where he tracks his daily progress and experiments.

With a background in creative collaboration, Saptashwa excels in teamwork and clear communication. He is adept at explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and thrives in collaborative environments.
A guitarist and music producer for 6+ years, he brings a unique sense of rhythm and flow to his UI/UX designs. He views a well-coded website like a well-composed song—everything must be in sync.
Saptashwa is deeply into literature, poetry, and books. This passion for storytelling helps him create web experiences that are intentional and narratively driven, rather than just functional.
He is based in Siliguri, India, often called the 'City of Hospitality.' He is open to remote opportunities worldwide and local collaborations within the tech community.
You can reach Saptashwa via the Contact page on this site. He is always open to discussing web development, creative projects, or the latest in music and literature.
